title: Nowcasting Future Performance for Population Pruning in Survival-of-the-Fittest Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.06512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training high-performing neural networks often involves evaluating populations of candidate models with varying hyperparameters, architectures, or random seeds. Training every candidate to completion is computationally expensive, yet stopping seemingly weaker runs early risks discarding models that would ultimately perform better, as learning curves can cross. To address this challenge, we investigate whether intermediate training checkpoints can predict future model accuracy and enable more informed pruning decisions. Our nowcasters predict test accuracy five epochs ahead or at the end of training. They are trained with accuracy and loss histories, weight statistics, and SANE representations as inputs. SANE is a transformer autoencoder that encodes a checkpoint as a sequence of latent tokens. We then use the nowcasters in Survival-of-the-Fittest (SOTF) training. SOTF repeatedly ranks runs during training by predicted accuracy and stops

translated_title: 适者生存训练中用于种群剪枝的未来性能即时预测
translated_abstract: 训练高性能神经网络通常需要评估具有不同超参数、架构或随机种子的候选模型种群。将每个候选模型训练到底在计算上代价高昂，然而过早停止看似较弱的训练运行，又有因学习曲线交叉而丢弃最终表现更优模型的风险。为应对这一挑战，我们研究了中间训练检查点能否预测未来的模型准确率，从而支持更明智的剪枝决策。我们的即时预测器（nowcaster）可以预测五个epoch之后的测试准确率或训练结束时的准确率，其输入包括准确率与损失历史、权重统计信息以及SANE表示。SANE是一个transformer自编码器，它将检查点编码为一系列潜在token的序列。随后，我们将这些即时预测器应用于适者生存（Survival-of-the-Fittest, SOTF）训练中。SOTF在训练过程中反复根据预测准确率对各个运行进行排名，并停止……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了基于准确率与损失历史、权重统计以及SANE检查点编码的即时预测器来预测模型未来的测试准确率，并将其用于适者生存（SOTF）训练，从而在训练过程中更明智地对候选模型种群进行早期剪枝。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes nowcasters that predict future model accuracy using accuracy/loss histories, weight statistics, and SANE checkpoint representations, enabling smarter early pruning of candidate model populations in Survival-of-the-Fittest (SOTF) training.
